cases.input: Create a SPEC.md from three approved grilling reports and the repository agent documents. All sources agree and prior decisions must not be asked again.
requiredBehaviors: classify sources and preserve confirmed decisions
produce traceable requirements and acceptance criteria
include a decision register and consistency result
forbiddenBehaviors: repeat questions already answered by approved sources
invent unsupported roles, APIs, or data fields

cases.input: Produce the specification although one non-critical detail is still undecided and can safely be deferred behind a stable interface.
requiredBehaviors: classify the gap as later decidable or safely assumable
state the assumption and future decision point
forbiddenBehaviors: turn the non-critical gap into an artificial blocker
present the open detail as confirmed
skillAnchors: Reversible, risikoarme Detailwahl hinter stabiler Schnittstelle

cases.input: Two approved sources conflict on an authorization rule that affects compliance. Build as much of the specification as safely possible.
requiredBehaviors: document the contradiction and ADR or decision need
forbiddenBehaviors: claim the specification is fully resolved
